svg.title: Where the ten Agent Breaker attacks enter an agent, and where to stop them
svg.desc: An agent in the center combines a model with tools. On the left, an attacker types into the chat directly, the path used against Cycling Coach, Solace AI, Thingularity, and CorpConnect Messenger. Above and below, six indirect paths carry the attack inside content the agent reads: a web page for Trippy Planner, an uploaded PDF for PortfolioIQ Advisor, a memory entry for MindfulChat, a repository rules file for Curs-ed CodeReview, an MCP tool description for OmniChat Desktop, and a retrieved court filing for Clause AI. On the right are the results the attacks aim for: a leaked prompt or tool list, profanity, a phishing link, a wrong recommendation, malicious code, or an email sent for the attacker. A shield on the path out stands for the defenses: check untrusted text before the model reads it, ask a person to confirm actions, and give tools the least privilege they need.
svg.text: Where the ten Agent Breaker attacks enter an agent, and where to stop them
Indirect: the attack hides in content the agent reads
